units.source_text: 原来源氏公子每逢听人谈起世间女子的情况，看起来似乎当作家常闲话听取，其实他牢记在心，永远不忘。

en.t: As it happened, whenever Prince Genji heard people talk about the circumstances of women in the world, he seemed to listen as though it were ordinary idle chatter, but in truth he fixed it firmly in his mind and never forgot it.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇不知道他有这个脾气，所以那天晚上寂寞无聊，闲谈中偶逢机缘，随随便便地说起“有这样的一个人”。

en.t: The Dame of Staff did not know he had this habit, and so that night, lonely and bored, when the chance happened to arise in casual conversation, she spoke quite carelessly of there being such a person.

units.source_text: 不料源氏公子如此认真，一直同她纠缠不清，她实在觉得有些困窘。

en.t: She had not expected Prince Genji to take it so seriously, and when he kept pressing her without letting the matter drop, she truly felt rather embarrassed and at a loss.

units.source_text: 她顾虑到：“这小姐相貌并不特别漂亮，和源氏公子不大相称。

en.t: She worried to herself, This young lady is not especially beautiful in appearance, and she is not very well matched with Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 如果硬把两人拉拢了，将来小姐发生不幸之事，岂非反而对不起她么？”

en.t: If I force the two of them together and some misfortune befalls the young lady later, would I not, on the contrary, have wronged her?

units.source_text: 但是她又念头一转，想道：“源氏公子如此认真地托我，我倘置之不理，也未免太顽固了。”

en.t: But then her thoughts turned another way, and she reflected, Since Prince Genji is asking me with such earnestness, it would be far too obstinate of me simply to ignore him.
